title: Add transport hardening baseline with secure cookie and HSTS controls
description:
Problem: cookie-based auth currently lacks explicit secure transport hardening defaults for non-loopback deployments.

Desired outcome: provide configurable, safe-by-default transport controls that keep localhost development functional while hardening remote scenarios.

Scope:
- In scope: configurable cookie secure policy, HSTS option, and remote-safe defaults with explicit compatibility overrides.
- Out of scope: external load balancer certificate automation.

Acceptance criteria:
- Cookie secure policy is explicitly configurable and defaults to safe behavior for remote exposure.
- HSTS can be enabled through settings/profile with clear admin guidance.
- Localhost workflow remains functional with documented compatibility path.

Validation:
- Add/extend tests for secure-cookie and HSTS behavior under local vs remote profile settings.
- Run targeted auth and startup guard tests.

Rollback:
- Disable hardened transport toggles through admin settings/profile if compatibility regressions are discovered.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Created from security audit finding F-002 to enforce transport hardening without impeding localhost functionality.
